<a id="testing-within-registration--识之内的检验"></a>
# Testing within registration

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`testing-within-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](testing-within-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A claim is refuted only through a difference in what registers, and refutation relative to a model refutes the model and the claim together. Where members respond only through their own registration, nothing beyond the registration closure registers within it; testing is relational.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A formation registers its support (whether the levels admit it) and the levels of the conditions it observes; the base registers support only. Under two level histories it registers alike at a step when the levels admit it alike and its observed conditions stand alike, and alike up to a step when it does so at every step up to it. (`Becoming.thresholdOnly`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThrough`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo`)
2. With every other registered condition alike, a condition depended on and not observed registers only whether it meets the need; an observed one registers its level; observing more distinguishes more. (`Becoming.Web.alike_of_threshold`, `Becoming.Web.observed_level_couples`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo.of_obs`)
3. A claim about level histories is refuted at a step when no history meeting it registers alike with the actual one up to that step: a claim is refuted only through a difference in what registers, what holds is never refuted, a refutation stands, and observing more refutes more. (`Becoming.Web.Excludes`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.not_of_alike`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.not_meets`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.later`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.widen`)
4. Without a model, for any finite record, neither the claim that a condition comes to nothing nor the claim that it stays above nothing afterwards is refuted. (`Becoming.Web.tail_unexcluded`)
5. Refutation relative to a model, a class of admissible histories, is exactly refutation of the model and the claim together; relative to a flow's balanced level histories, the actual one among them, a formation observing a stock refutes at the first step every false claim that it comes to nothing; a wrong model refutes what holds, and registration refutes the model. (`Becoming.Web.ExcludesWithin`, `Becoming.Web.excludesWithin_iff_conjunction`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancedHistory`, `Becoming.Flow.excludes_tail_within`, `Becoming.Stationary.model_error`, `Becoming.Stationary.model_excluded`)
6. A formation's belief is the histories registering alike with the actual one; refutation is a claim disjoint from the belief; a judgment from registration is exactly a common response of the judging process of Becoming.Inquiry over the belief, kept as later steps and more observation narrow it. (`Becoming.Web.ClassThrough`, `Becoming.Web.class_excludes_iff`, `Becoming.Web.class_judge_iff`, `Becoming.Web.class_judge_later`, `Becoming.Web.class_judge_widen`)
7. A formation registers a condition when it depends on it or observes it; the registration closure is the closure under being affected through what is registered, holding the influence closure, equal to it registering support only, and growing with observation and exchange. (`Becoming.Web.CoupledInto`, `Becoming.Flow.CoupledFrom`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinCoupling`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_of_withinInfluence`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_thresholdOnly`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_mono_obs`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_mono_flow`)
8. For two flows with the same formations present, balancing at each step on every condition a member of a region registers, the region closed in both under being affected through what is registered, the levels starting alike on what members register, and each member taking from and giving to what members register alike wherever it has registered alike, every member registers alike at every step. (`Becoming.Flow.alike_within_closed`)
9. With the rest of the exchange fixed and balance at each step on what is registered within the closure, a part whose members all lie beyond the registration closure is registered alike with and without it at every step within it; no claim met by the levels without it is refuted there; a refutation there relative to a model rests on the model excluding its exchange; a judgment there is admissible with and without it. (`Becoming.Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.uncoupled_beyond_influence`, `Becoming.Flow.unexcluded_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.beyond_needs_model`, `Becoming.Flow.class_judge_beyond`)
10. In Clearing the clearer registers alike at every step whether or not its clearing ends the dweller; with the habitat spared, the claim that the dweller is ended is refuted by the clearer at no step and by the dweller at the third step; the claim that the dweller or the clearer is not admitted at the third step is refuted by neither alone and by the two together. (`Becoming.Clearing.alike_for_clearer`, `Becoming.Clearing.DwellerEnded`, `Becoming.Clearing.tested_by_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.EitherEnded`, `Becoming.Web.ExcludesBy`, `Becoming.Clearing.pooled`)
11. With a model fixing the start and the exchange, the clearer refutes at the first step what it does not register. (`Becoming.Clearing.FixedStartAndExchange`, `Becoming.Clearing.model_idles_coupling`)
12. In Prey, the prey not depending on itself, the predator lies beyond its influence closure and within its registration closure under a gauge of itself: the prey registers the predator's part alike through support at every step, and the gauge registers the taking after the bite; this rests on omitted relations. (`Becoming.ownStanding`, `Becoming.Prey.couples_taking`, `Becoming.Prey.omits`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The definitions of registration and refutation assume nothing; a model is a supplied class of admissible histories.
- Balance is assumed only on the conditions registered, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn, singleton families, needing no finiteness); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on.
- Flow.alike_within_closed further assumes the region closed in both flows, the starts alike, and the members responding only through their own registration, all supplied: how others respond is supplied. The comparison with and without a part uses withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels, the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation); a part is a decided family of formations.
- Registration: support and the levels of the conditions observed (obs, a parameter); activity is supplied by the representation and is not counted as registered. Refutation is by one formation, at a step, under one level history; a claim is any proposition about level histories.
- Whether a formation's own standing counts as registered (Ren's question 4) was decided by the AI after exploring the options: the base registers support only (supportOnly); in the one-kind reading own standing registers through self-bearing (Web.SelfBearing) as a threshold; a gauge of oneself (ownStanding) is an observation premise. The reasons are in the integration note.
- For the witnesses: their flows, webs and models (Clearing, Prey, Stationary).
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions (DecidableEq) is used only to split cases on conditions, and no classical reasoning is used.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Each feedback blindness holds only in its scope: below threshold where exchange follows registration, beyond the horizon where continuation is open, beyond the registration closure where members respond only through their own registration.
- The laws do not derive that a formation observes anything beyond its support, forms a model, wants to test or knows its registration closure.
- Registering alike bounds what can be told apart and says nothing of what a difference is about.
- What an act does compares two histories and is testable only relative to a model of the history without it; varying one's own act and registering the difference (experiment) is not stated here.
- **Counterexample:** Refutation relative to a model can err: in Stationary the model says nothing takes or gives, and relative to it a formation gauging the stock refutes at the first step the claim that the stock comes to nothing, which holds of the actual history (Stationary.model_error). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The registration closure can be strictly larger than the influence closure: in Prey the predator lies beyond the prey's influence closure and, under a gauge of itself, within its registration closure (Prey.couples_taking); the registered difference does nothing to the prey, which does not bear on itself (Prey.omits), so the witness rests on omitted relations. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's proposal: “can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”, and “I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”. The AI's answer proposed three blindnesses of feedback, a runaway as a loop running inside one of them, the ways across them, falsifiability as the condition of being corrected by the unfolding, and a reading of 理; Ren answered “agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”. The independent review narrowed the readings: each blindness has its scope (a does-not-show item states it); the runaway reading is a heuristic, not a statement; and 理, read by the AI as a model answerable to registration, is now read as Ren read it on 12 October 2026, the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; a model is still tested only through registration (generalization-through-lumping). So the readings here are the AI's narrowed ones, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D26), not the wording Ren accepted.
